overview: I do want to note that HUD Secretary Scott Turner committed to this committee that the Trump administration is working with us to stop waste, fraud and abuse in federally funded housing programs to make sure housing authorities follow the rules and follow the law. What's occurred here in Little Rock was a failure at multiple levels of failure with individuals running public housing agency to work in the best interest of our residents and a failure to the Department of Housing and Urban Development to fulfill their important oversight role. I want to thank the Trump administration under the leadership of HUD Secretary Scott Turner for taking steps to strengthen their oversight of public housing, including here in Little Rock. I mean ideally when you know and here's one of the issues is that when when I came back we had three point seven million dollars in our bank account in HUD what they call HUD health reserves and HUD came in and had after telling us that they would not sweep our reserves actually took our reserves and that's a practice that HUD does sometime where they come in and take your reserves and give it to other housing authorities. You know this is this is incredibly important to this committee to me making sure that there is stewardship accountability oversight and programs especially something as important is housing and so I really appreciate all the effort and the folks being here and I represent Montana second district and we've not been immune from these problems either surrounding public housing authorities and much like the Metropolitan Housing Alliance you know Richland County in my district has a history of poor financial management including misuse of credit cards insufficient financial documentation. I'm going to go back to Commissioner Wright you know prior to your time on the Little Rock Housing Commission you helped the Harris County Housing Authority overcome millions in theft so given your experience you know what similarities and what differences do MHA and the Harris County Housing Authority have and what impact does that have on MHA recovery.
